Select distinct semester as semester, sis_getters.get_semester_desc(semester, #{arabicLang}) semesterDesc sis_getters.get_semester_desc(semester, #{englishLang}) semesterDescS from sis_semesters order by semester desc

select A.SECTION_NO sectionNo, REPLACE(A.SECTION_DESC, '/', ' - ') sectionName, REPLACE(A.SECTION_DESC_S, '/', ' - ') sectionNameS, A.PARENT_SECTION parentSection, A.STAFF_ID managerId, lower(B.SAM_ACCOUNT_NAME) managerUsername from hrs_sections a, hrs_staff b where nvl(A.IS_SERVICE_SECTION,0) = 1 and A.STAFF_ID = B.STAFF_ID (+) order by 1

SELECT a.staff_id staffId, a.first_name firstName, a.last_name lastName, a.first_name || ' ' || a.father_name || ' ' || a.mid_name || ' ' || a.last_name staffName, a.first_name_s || ' ' || a.father_name_s || ' ' || a.mid_name_s || ' ' || a.last_name_s staffNameS, TO_CHAR (a.begin_work_date, 'dd-mm-yyyy') workStartDate, lower(a.sam_account_name) samAccountName, d.STATUS_DESC statusDesc, d.STATUS_DESC_S statusDescS, a.category_code userType, e.category_desc roleDesc, e.category_desc_s roleDescS, B.SECTION_NO sectionNo, b.SECTION_DESC sectionDesc, b.SECTION_DESC_S sectionDescS, c.JOB_NAME jobName, c.JOB_NAME_S jobNameS, A.E_MAIL email, A.MOBILE mobile FROM hrs_staff a, hrs_sections b, hrs_jobs c, hrs_assign_status d, hrs_employment_categories e, GEN_COUNTRIES f WHERE a.section_no = b.section_no AND a.job_no = c.job_no AND a.status_code = d.status_code AND a.category_code = e.category_code AND a.sam_account_name IS NOT NULL and A.NATIONALITY = F.COUNTRY_NO (+) AND D.STATUS_CODE IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12) AND B.SECTION_NO IN ( SELECT A.SECTION_NO FROM HRS_SECTIONS a START WITH A.SECTION_NO = #{sectionNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR A.SECTION_NO = A.PARENT_SECTION) order by B.PARENT_SECTION
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BPM_AUDIT_LOG ( CASE_ID, REQUESTOR_ID, DOCUMENT_CODE, ENTRY_USER, ENTRY_DATE, TERMINAL, OS_USER) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{requesterId}, #{documentType}, #{entryUser}, sysdate, #{terminal}, #{osUser})

INSERT INTO BPM_AUDIT_LOG_DTL ( SERIAL, CASE_ID, ACTION_CODE, NOTE, ENTRY_USER, ENTRY_DATE, TERMINAL, OS_USER, IS_FINISHED) VALUES ( (select nvl(max(serial),0) + 1 from BPM_AUDIT_LOG_DTL where case_id = #{caseId}) , #{caseId},#{action} , #{note}, #{entryUser}, sysdate, #{terminal}, #{osUser}, #{finished})

INSERT INTO BPM_CASE_ATTACHMENTS ( CASE_ID, CONTENT_ID, CONTENT_NAME, ENTRY_DATE, ENTRY_USER, OS_USER, SERIAL, TERMINAL) VALUES ( #{caseId}, #{contentId}, #{contentName}, sysdate, #{entryUser}, #{osUser}, (SELECT nvl(max(serial),0) + 1 FROM BPM_CASE_ATTACHMENTS), #{terminal})
mapper.select: select 1 from BPM_AUDIT_LOG a where A.CASE_ID = #{caseId}
select bpm_pkg.check_bpm_service_period(#{studentId},#{semester},#{documentCode}) from dual
select bpm_pkg.check_bpm_service_payment(#{studentId},#{semester},#{documentCode}) from dual

{call BPM_PKG.check_presubmit_bpm_service( #{studentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{semester, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{documentCode, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{courseNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{courseEdition, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{activityCode, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{section, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{lang, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{msg, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=OUT}, #{status, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=OUT})}

select semester semester, trans_code transCode, sis_getters.get_ststatus(trans_code, 1) transDesc, sis_getters.get_ststatus(trans_code, 2) transDescS from sis_semester_trans where student_id = #{studentId}
select school_avg schoolAvg, sis_getters.get_student_cum_gpa(student_id) cumGpa from sis_students where student_id = #{studentId}

select a.semester semester, a.probation_code probationCode, b.probation_desc probationDesc, b.probation_desc_s probationDescS from sis_academic_records a, sis_probation_levels b where a.probation_code = b.probation_code and a.system_code = b.system_code and a.edition = b.edition and student_id = #{studentId}

select a.start_semester startSemester, a.end_semester endSemester, a.sponser_id sponserId, sponser_name sponserName, sponser_name_s sponserNameS, a.exemption_no exemptionNo, b.exemption_desc exemptionDesc, b.exemption_desc_s exemptionDescS, decode (a.end_semester, null , 1, 0) isActive from sas_student_exemptions a, sas_sponser_exemptions b, sas_sponsers c where a.sponser_id = b.sponser_id and a.exemption_no = b.exemption_no and a.sponser_id = c.sponser_id and a.student_id = #{studentId}

{call bpm_pkg.get_bpm_service_price( #{studentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{semester, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{documentCode, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{msg, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=OUT}, #{msgS, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=OUT}, #{status, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=OUT})}

{call BPM_PKG.insert_student_claims( #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{documentCode, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{lang, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, #{msg, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=OUT}, #{status, jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=OUT})}
SELECT time_code AS timeCode, A.START_TIME startTime, A.END_TIME endTime, sis_getters.get_time (time_code, 1) timeDesc FROM sis_times a
select semester from sas_financial_calendar where nvl(is_closed, 0) = 0 and semester > (select nvl(max( semester) , 0) from sas_financial_calendar where nvl(is_closed, 0) = 1 ) order by semester desc

select a.case_id caseId, a.requestor_id requestorId, a.document_code documentCode, a.entry_user entryUser, a.entry_date entryDate, a.terminal, a.os_user osUser FROM BPM_AUDIT_LOG a, BPM_AUDIT_LOG_DTL b WHERE A.CASE_ID = B.CASE_ID AND A.DOCUMENT_CODE = #{documentCode} and B.IS_FINISHED = 1 and A.REQUESTOR_ID = #{userId}

select a.staff_id staffId, nvl(hrs_pkg.get_staff_name(a.staff_id,4),hrs_pkg.get_staff_name_s(a.staff_id,4)) staffName, nvl(hrs_pkg.get_staff_name_s(a.staff_id,4),hrs_pkg.get_staff_name(a.staff_id,4)) staffNameS, sam_account_name samAccountName, a.section_no sectionNo, nvl(section_desc,SECTION_DESC_S) sectionDesc, nvl(section_desc_S,SECTION_DESC) sectionDescS from hrs_staff a, hrs_sections b where a.section_no = b.section_no and a.section_no = #{sectionNo} and a.staff_id != #{staffId} and HRS_PKG.IS_ON_DUTY(a.staff_id) = 1
select section_no from hrs_Sections where section_no in ( select section_no from hrs_sections a connect by prior section_no = a.parent_section start with staff_id = #{staffId}) order by 1

SELECT b.staff_id staffId, b.first_name firstName, b.last_name lastName, b.first_name || ' ' || b.father_name || ' ' || b.mid_name || ' ' || b.last_name staffName, b.first_name_s || ' ' || b.father_name_s || ' ' || b.mid_name_s || ' ' || b.last_name_s staffNameS, TO_CHAR (b.begin_work_date, 'dd-mm-yyyy') workStartDate, lower(b.sam_account_name) samAccountName, a.section_no sectionNo, nvl(section_desc,SECTION_DESC_S) sectionDesc, nvl(section_desc_S,SECTION_DESC) sectionDescS, d.STATUS_DESC statusDesc, d.STATUS_DESC_S statusDescS, b.category_code userType, e.category_desc roleDesc, e.category_desc_s roleDescS, c.JOB_NAME jobName, c.JOB_NAME_S jobNameS, b.E_MAIL email, b.MOBILE mobile from hrs_sections a, hrs_staff b ,hrs_assign_status d, hrs_employment_categories e, hrs_jobs c where a.staff_id = b.staff_id(+) AND d.status_code(+) = b.status_code AND e.category_code = b.category_code AND c.job_no = b.job_no and parent_section = #{sectionNo}
